question: What quantitative residual or load restriction survives a general passive bath for the proposed UD seven-orbit source?
assumptions: The archived seven-orbit source S(w) is adopted as a proposed physical map.
The internal low-frequency bath is an arbitrary symmetric PSD operator at each pressure.
The conventional baseline and contact readout are treated as separately fixed for attribution.
physical_mapping: HYPOTHESIS: harmonic quotient source to graphite displacement-force coupling; material weights, damping and force units OPEN
target_exposure: Observed paired angles and weak load dependence were known; no held-out friction dataset used in this calculation
baseline: Ordinary honeycomb/moiré coincidence plus independently measured material PES, contact and loss; an unrestricted passive conventional bath is observationally equivalent at the output
result: EXACT/CONDITIONAL: rank S=2 for every nonuniform orbit weight and {SLS^T:L PSD} is the entire PSD cone in 2D; with pressure-varying L, the local positive-friction load slope is unrestricted. Uniform weights force this added channel to zero.
next_discriminant: Measure source cross-Hessian and loss independently, restrict admissible L and w before a held-out signed paired-angle force/load test
